[Unit]
Description=Attach loop device and activate vg_data for /srv/data
DefaultDependencies=no
Before=local-fs.target
After=systemd-udevd.service
Requires=systemd-udevd.service

[Service]
Type=oneshot
RemainAfterExit=yes
ExecStart=/sbin/losetup -f /var/lib/srv-backing/disk.img
ExecStart=/sbin/vgchange -ay vg_data
ExecStop=/sbin/vgchange -an vg_data

[Install]
WantedBy=local-fs.target
